title: QUIC RFC 9221 DATAGRAM Foundation Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, codec unit tests, codec fuzz support, runtime send/receive tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9221 DATAGRAM foundation and core send slice.
scope: This verification covers canonical requirement presence plus executable proof for transport parameter `0x20`, DATAGRAM frame types `0x30` and `0x31`, 0-RTT parameter-memory validation, ack-eliciting classification, receive-side 1-RTT DATAGRAM delivery/rejection, and core outbound 1-RTT DATAGRAM send behavior. It does not yet verify HTTP Datagrams adapter behavior, optional application ACK/loss notifications, 0-RTT DATAGRAM transmission, or benchmark evidence.
preconditions: The repo remains in the JSON-only SpecTrace workflow.
The local RFC 9221 source text is represented by upstream references until a repo-local RFC corpus file is added.
Runtime application DATAGRAM send support is limited to peer-gated 1-RTT DATAGRAM frames over the active connection path.
expected_result: Focused RFC9221 requirement-home tests pass, transport-parameter, DATAGRAM frame codec, receive-side delivery/rejection, weak-packet-context, ack-eliciting, outbound peer-support gating, peer-limit enforcement, non-fragmentation, congestion/drop, non-retransmission, and flow-control exclusion behavior are proven for the covered positive, negative, edge, and fuzz-shaped inputs, core SpecTrace validation accepts the JSON artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: Focused RFC 9221 verification now covers the transport-parameter, codec, 0-RTT parameter-memory, ack-eliciting, weak-context rejection, receive-side 1-RTT delivery/rejection, and core outbound 1-RTT DATAGRAM send floor. HTTP Datagrams adapter behavior, public receive API shape, optional DATAGRAM ACK/loss notifications, 0-RTT DATAGRAM transmission, and benchmarks remain deferred.
